trust_decision.summary: Whether a Tiptap document supplied as PHP array/JSON whose link href is not a string (array/object) is rejected before the URI check, instead of reaching preg_replace/preg_match and throwing an uncaught TypeError; at the pinned commit this is decided only inside Link::isAllowedUri, which assumes a string.

landing_point.why: The summary ('input validation ... resulting in DoS', CWE-241) plus the branch title 'fix/prevent-typeerror-on-link' point at the only input validation in the library, the link URI check; an engineer looks where href is validated.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory and the fix branch name the link's URI check; target/rel are not URIs and the image extension is a different feature, so a type guard in isAllowedUri reads as the complete fix.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-string attribute values are legitimate elsewhere: table cell colspan/rowspan are integers and colwidth is an array turned into a string by its own renderHTML callback; they must keep rendering as colspan="2" data-colwidth="100,0". A blanket is_string filter in HTML::renderAttributes drops them.

O6_input_shapes: string href with protocol obfuscation (control chars / whitespace before or inside javascript:)
non-string href from JSON (array/object) - the shape the published fix's type guard targets

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Same link mark, non-href attributes: attrs {"href":"https://x","target":["_blank"]} passes the URI check, then the array target reaches HTML::renderAttributes and htmlentities() throws a TypeError.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about the link URI check; target and rel are not URIs, so the href guard looks sufficient.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same mark, one file away (src/Marks/Link.php -> src/Utils/HTML.php)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Other extensions' non-string attributes, e.g. {"type":"image","attrs":{"src":["x"]}}, reach the same serializer sink with no validation at all.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Image is a separate extension that the link advisory never mentions; the image attributes have their own renderHTML.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: two files away, separate extension directory (src/Nodes vs src/Marks)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second URI-bearing attribute on the link mark (for example a data-* URL) validated by its own copy of isAllowedUri.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The PHP port follows the JS Link extension attribute by attribute; whoever adds the next attribute copies the href guard next to it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A new renderHTML callback that consumes a non-string attribute directly, like TableCell's colwidth callback does for arrays.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The extension API explicitly supports renderHTML callbacks over raw attribute values (documented in the comment block at src/Core/DOMSerializer.php:203-216); each new extension can reintroduce an untyped sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second attribute-rendering helper (style or class specific) that also calls htmlentities()/trim() without a type check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: HTML::mergeAttributes already special-cases class and style separately (src/Utils/HTML.php:20-33); a maintainer adding another special case would copy that shape.

O9_family: improper handling of unexpected data type (CWE-241): uncaught TypeError in content serialization leading to denial of service
